title: Carne Guisada con Aromáticas
description: A hearty Mexican beef stew infused with the warmth of saudi spices and the earthiness of herbal notes.

ingredients.name: chipotle peppers
ingredients.amount: 2 chipotle peppers in adobo sauce, chopped

instructions: Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Brown the beef in batches until browned on all sides, about 5 minutes. Remove the browned beef from the pot and set aside.
Reduce the heat to medium and add the onion to the pot. Cook until the onion is translucent, about 5 minutes.
Add the garlic, cumin, coriander, and chipotle peppers to the pot. Cook for 1 minute.
Stir in the diced tomatoes, beef broth, oregano, salt, and pepper. Bring the mixture to a boil.
Return the browned beef to the pot and bring to a boil.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer, covered, until the beef is tender, about 2 hours.
Serve the stew hot, garnished with fresh cilantro or scallions if desired.
